newsitem.title: UK: US stocks hold firm in London, Dow seen higher.
newsitem.headline: US stocks hold firm in London, Dow seen higher.

text.p: U.S. shares held firm in London on Tuesday and dealers expected Wall Street to move further into record territory at the open.
Trading was thin, however, they said.
Investors focused on shares in AT&T Corp and SBC Communications Inc amid talk the two telecommunications concerns may form a linkup, dealers said.
"There's a bit of speculation of some kind of merger. That's the main feature," said one London dealer.
Shares in AT&T rose $5/8 to $36-3/4, while shares in SBC climbed $1 to $57-7/8.
Most other shares were steady to firmer, though volumes were light, they said.
Shares in Digital Equipment Corp firmed $1/2 to $36-3/4 after news reports that shareholders were to meet to discuss ways to increase the stock price, dealers said.
Shares in bellwethers IBM and Intel were unchanged from their closing levels in New York on Friday at $173-3/8 and $163-3/16.
In other trading, June S&P 500 index futures were up 1.10 points to 848.85 on Globex at 1009 GMT, while June long bond futures were up 2/32 to 109-8/32.
